description: Create a new task in Teamleader Focus. The Teamleader API requires a title, a due date and a work type. Use teamleader_work_types_list to find a work_type_id.

customer_id.description: Link task to a customer ID

customer_type.description: Link task to a customer type

deal_id.description: Link task to a deal ID

project_id.description: Link task to a project ID (new projects module)

work_type_id.description: Work type ID (required). Use teamleader_work_types_list to find one.

name: teamleader_create_task
